description: This file defines the EventService class responsible for managing event data, including listing events, fetching event details by ID, and generating mock seat maps for an event within a ticket booking frontend application.

classes.name: EventService
classes.description: A service class that provides methods to retrieve and generate event and seating information.

methods.name: listEvents
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of events, optionally filtered by query and location.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves detailed information of a specific event by its ID.

methods.name: seats
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a seat map for a given event, with some seats marked as reserved.
